fix: Every non-skipped rebuild of an element with static children clones its child Vec (here) and collects `desired` into a new Vec (line 844). Avoid both per update: move the mounted list out with `std::mem::take(&mut element.children)` before reconciling and restore it on the error path, and let reconcile_children take `desired` as a borrowed iterator (or a tree-owned scratch buffer) instead of a fresh Vec<&Widget>.

`next` is allocated on every call, but the caller (line 846) discards it when `reconciled == previous`, which is the steady state. Return an outcome that says whether the child list changed, and only build the `next` vector once a non-prefix difference is found (or write the prefix into a tree-owned scratch buffer).

reconcile_sliver_children runs per sliver layout pass and allocates twice before reconciling: the old key Vec via `.to_vec()` (only to dodge the &mut self borrow) and a `desired` Vec with one cloned widget per child (lines 1004-1011). Store the key list as `Arc<[K]>`/`Rc<[K]>` in the scrolling state so the borrow is a refcount bump, and reuse a tree-owned scratch Vec for `desired` (clear + extend) instead of collecting a new one each pass.

Same pattern as the sliver path: `old_keys` is copied with `.to_vec()` (line 1095) and `desired` is re-collected into a new Vec of DesiredDynamicChild (lines 1097-1100) on every advanced-scrolling layout pass. Share the key list (Arc<[K]>) or take it out with `std::mem::take` and restore it, and accept the converted Vec from a reusable scratch buffer rather than allocating each pass.

reconcile_dynamic_children_inner builds five hash containers and one Vec clone on every call, i.e. on every sliver or advanced-scroll materialization: `seen` (1145), `old_children` clone (1173-1176), `existing` (1178-1182, which also clones every K), `keyed_index` with one Vec per key (1190-1199), `old_positions` (1207-1212), and `retained` (1213). Fold the duplicate-key check, the old-position map and the retained set into one pass over reusable scratch containers owned by the tree (cleared each call, capacity kept), and index old children by position instead of hashing them.

fix: Both buffers are created per sliver pass and then stored into scrolling state (lines 1074-1075), dropping the previous pass's buffers. Take the stored Vec and set out with `std::mem::take`, `clear()` them, refill, and store them back so steady-state passes allocate nothing.

Only runs when the middle section is non-empty, but then it allocates a SipHash HashSet and inserts every reused child. `used` can be a `Vec<bool>` of length old_middle.len() indexed by the old position already stored in `keyed`/`unkeyed_ids` (line 944 would set `used[old_position] = true`), and `kept` can be the same kind of vector. This also removes the inconsistent std hasher when the file already uses FastHashSet (line 1057).

Key::String is an owned String, so `.cloned()` allocates for every string-keyed old child on every middle reconciliation (line 915), and again for every keyed child on every dynamic reconciliation (line 1195). Index the keyed map by a borrowed or cheap identity (e.g. intern keys as Rc<str>/u64, or store the position and compare `element.widget.key()` through a reference in a second pass) so no String is copied per frame.

sync_edit_callbacks is called from every non-skipped update of a TextField (line 750) and tears down both subscriptions and registers new boxed subscriptions even when the transform and changed callbacks are the same Rc values as before. Compare the old and new spec callbacks (Rc::ptr_eq on the transform and changed handles, and the controller) and keep the existing subscriptions when they match.
